_doc: Perks (GDD 6). Perks change options or resources, never flat accuracy/damage/defence.

perks.name: Spell Satchel
perks.desc: Freeze spells cost no runes this life (otherwise 30 casts).

perks.name: Snare Trap
perks.desc: Place one trap (hotkey T). An enemy who steps on it is frozen 5 s.

perks.name: Spare Spec
perks.desc: Start each life with 100% spec plus a 25% spec restore potion.

perks.name: Rebuke
perks.desc: Hotkey T, every 30 s: the next hit taken reflects 75% of its damage.

perks.name: Antivenom
perks.desc: Immune to poison and venom for the whole life.

perks.name: Steady Hand
perks.desc: Special energy regenerates twice as fast.

perks.name: Unbound
perks.desc: Freeze immunity after a freeze lasts 3 s instead of 5.

perks.name: Quick Hands
perks.desc: Up to 10 equips per tick instead of 8.

perks.name: Shadowstep
perks.desc: Hidden from the Scrying Orb streak.

perks.name: Eagle Sight
perks.desc: See enemy overhead prayers from 5 tiles further away.

perks.name: Second Wind
perks.desc: Once per life, below 10 HP, heal 15 HP over 5 ticks.
